description: Render a UI sketch built from the company's own components in the warm Lab: `story_source` is a Storybook CSF story (TypeScript) that imports components from the repo (component_catalog lists them) and composes the screen. It renders at each width × theme (375 and 1440, light and dark by default) and comes back with a PNG and an HTML page per view, console errors, and which components it used or made new. Unless `save: false`, it is saved to the company's Knowledge as a clickable `page` mockup (with `content.sketch`) and the result has its `app_url`. It spends Lab time, so you confirm in a dialog first.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

interactive.description: a clickable HTML build of the story (true by default); false keeps a static snapshot

repo.description: the repo whose components it uses: full name (owner/repo) or id

save.description: save it as a page mockup in Knowledge (true by default)

story_source.description: the story: CSF that imports the repo's components and renders the screen

themes.description: light, dark or both (both by default)

title.description: what the sketch shows, e.g. "Plans dialog after a launch"

variants.description: the story's exports to render, when it has several (Default when left out)

name: sketch_ui
title: Sketch a screen
